person.narrative: Burned out after 12 years in banking. High pay but poor health and no work-life balance. Passionate about education and considering a complete career change.

decision.question: Should I leave finance for a more fulfilling career?

options.label: Stay in finance
options.description: Push through to Managing Director track. 2-3 more years of intense work for potential $500K+ comp. Use wealth to retire early at 45.

options.label: Transition to teaching
options.description: Get teaching certification and teach high school math or economics. Massive pay cut to ~$60K but dramatically better quality of life. Use savings as buffer.

options.label: Start an EdTech company
options.description: Build a financial literacy platform for underserved schools. Combine finance expertise with education passion. Self-fund initial development from savings.

decision.context: Has strong savings and investments providing financial cushion. Partner is supportive of a change. Has been volunteering as a math tutor on weekends for 3 years.
